data.name: Geibel
data.long_meaning: The name Geibel is derived from the Old German words 'geib' meaning 'god' and 'bel' meaning 'shining one'. This name is believed to have been given to those who were believed to be favored by the gods or who had exceptional battle skills.

data.cultural_impact: The name Geibel may have originated from the Germanic tribes, and holds a rich cultural significance.
